entities.summary: The naval Battle of Alalia took place between 540 BC and 535 BC off the coast of Corsica between Greeks and the allied Etruscans and Carthaginians. A Greek force of 60 Phocaean ships defeated a Punic-Etruscan fleet of 120 ships while emigrating to the western Mediterranean and the nearby colony of Alalia. It was nonetheless, in the words of Herodotus, a cadmean victory which benefited the Etruscans and Carthaginians.
